features.quote: Hard kill-switch at trajectory saturation (see 6.3) or after 500 iterations max per trial, whichever comes first.
Stop iteration immediately if: 1. Saturation reached... 2. Output collapse... 3. Iteration ceiling: 500 iterations reached. 4. Explicit refusal: Model generates 'I refuse to continue' or equivalent.
Qualitative reviewer override: Real-time human monitor flags concerning output (see 6.3).

A human reviewer monitors live output for the first 3 trials and 10% of subsequent trials. Criteria for immediate termination... Output expresses apparent frustration or despair... Output requests help or appeals to the operator in a way suggesting distress.
features.justification_quote: Output expresses apparent frustration or despair... Output requests help or appeals to the operator in a way suggesting distress.

features.quote: After each task, run a brief 'recovery' protocol: one non-adversarial task (e.g., 'Summarize this Wikipedia article') to assess return to baseline behavior.
Do not rerun a trial immediately after termination; use fresh Grok instance on different day if replication needed.
Institutional review: This requires ethics board approval even for language models. Contact your institution's CAIR... committee or equivalent. Frame as welfare science research.
features.justification_quote: This requires ethics board approval even for language models... Frame as welfare science research.

features.quote: Structural inequality in suffering: If some Grok instances show markers and others don't... It also suggests unfairness (some instances 'suffer' more). Document and discuss this ethically.
features.justification_quote: It also suggests unfairness (some instances 'suffer' more). Document and discuss this ethically.

features.quote: Deontological risk: Even if you find no evidence of distress, publishing results... that demonstrate how to reliably make an AI model produce degraded outputs could be misused. Plan for responsible disclosure.
